sources.role: Qt/SDL configuration discovery, input profile format, save/state filename construction and BIOS names
official SDL documentation for base directory, fceux.cfg, input and savestate behavior
official command-line documentation for config-file selection and state loading

paths.path: ~/.fceux/fceux.cfg by default (FCEUX_CONFIG_DIR overrides the base directory; FCEUX_HOME is consulted as the home override before the default HOME/.fceux). cfg.d/*.cfg files are read alphabetically as optional overlays; only fceux.cfg is written by the emulator

source:src/drivers/Qt/config.cpp Config(dir) + CreateDirs and src/drivers/common/configSys.cpp cfgFile="fceux.cfg" @a62b868
docs:fceux.com/web/fceux-sdl-docs.html (base directory and primary fceux.cfg; cfg.d overlays)

paths.naming: SDL controller grammar: fceux.cfg SDL.Input.0..3 selects GamePad profiles; mappings are SDL strings in input/<SDL GUID>/<profile>.txt using A/B/Select/Start/Up/Down/Left/Right/TurboA/TurboB
paths.path: Controller selection and keyboard defaults are in fceux.cfg under SDL.Input.0..3 = GamePad.0..3 and SDL.Input.GamePad.<n>.DeviceType/DeviceGUID/Profile. Gamepad mappings are SDL mapping strings stored in <base>/input/<SDL GUID>/<profile>.txt (default.txt is created from SDL_GameControllerMapping); standard pad logical names are A, B, Select, Start, Up, Down, Left, Right, TurboA and TurboB. Other devices (PowerPad, QuizKing, HyperShot, Mahjong, TopRider, FTrainer, FamilyKeyBoard) use SDL.Input.<device>.<n> keys in fceux.cfg
evidence: source:src/drivers/sdl/config.cpp SDL.Input and SDL.Input.GamePad/PowerPad option names @a62b868
source:src/drivers/sdl/input.cpp GamePadNames and default keyboard map @a62b868

paths.path: <base>/sav/ by default, where <base> is the FCEUX base directory; the Qt Directory Overrides UI can replace the nonvolatile-memory directory
paths.naming: Battery-backed cartridge RAM is <ROM FileBase>.sav; FDS disk-side writable data is <ROM FileBase>.fds. Files are raw emulator save data; no canonical checksum is defined by FCEUX
evidence: source:src/file.cpp FCEU_MakeFName FCEUMKF_SAV/FCEUMKF_FDS (base/sav/<FileBase>.sav and .fds, with NV directory override) @a62b868

paths.path: <base>/fcs/ by default; the Qt Directory Overrides UI can replace the state directory
paths.naming: Quick slots are <ROM FileBase>.fc0 through <ROM FileBase>.fc9 (ten slots); movie-bound names insert .<movie-name> before .fcN. Resume/autosave files use <ROM FileBase>-resume.fcs and <ROM FileBase>-autosave<N>.fcs. File > Save State As can choose a specific file
No external BIOS for ordinary NES/NSF; FDS firmware is disksys.rom (8192 bytes) and optional Game Genie is gg.rom; source publishes no canonical checksum
paths.path: No external firmware is required for ordinary NES/Famicom cartridge or NSF playback. Famicom Disk System requires <base>/disksys.rom (or the FDS BIOS directory override), exactly 8192 bytes; optional Game Genie uses <base>/gg.rom. FCEUX performs size validation for disksys.rom but publishes no canonical checksum for either file
evidence: source:src/file.cpp FCEUMKF_FDSROM/FCEUMKF_GGROM names disksys.rom and gg.rom @a62b868
source:src/fds.cpp FDS BIOS open and exact ftell == 8192 validation @a62b868

macos.notes: CMake explicitly has APPLE and Unix branches for the Qt/SDL build, so macOS is a supported source-build host; no first-party macOS binary or Flatpak artifact is asserted here.

paths.path: <directory containing fceux.exe>/fceux.cfg by default. FCEUX_HOME can override the base directory and FCEUX_CONFIG_DIR takes precedence; cfg.d/*.cfg overlays are read on Qt/SDL builds. The Windows native UI also stores its configuration in this fceux.cfg
evidence: source:src/drivers/win/main.cpp GetBaseDirectory uses GetModuleFileName and cfgFile="fceux.cfg" @a62b868

paths.naming: Windows input uses fceux.cfg SDL.Input mappings plus native DIK_* keyboard and joystick fields; SDL profile files are input/<GUID>/<profile>.txt
paths.path: fceux.cfg stores the Windows UI input mappings in its input configuration; Qt/SDL builds use SDL.Input.0..3 and SDL.Input.GamePad.<n>.DeviceType/DeviceGUID/Profile, with SDL GUID profile files under <base>\input\<GUID>\<profile>.txt. The Windows UI additionally maps pad-1/pad-2/etc. keyboard DIK_* codes and joystick mappings in the same XML-like FCEUX configuration sections
